items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingFunction where the ThrowingFunction.apply(Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建 `ThrowingFunction`，其中 `ThrowingFunction.apply(Object)` 方法使用给定的 `exceptionWrapper` 包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingFunction where the ThrowingFunction.apply(Object) method wraps any checked exception thrown by the supplied lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建 `ThrowingFunction`，其中 `ThrowingFunction.apply(Object)` 方法会包装由提供的 Lambda 表达式或方法引用抛出的任何受检异常。

items.source: Return a new ThrowingFunction where the ThrowingFunction.apply(Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: 返回一个新的ThrowingFunction，其中ThrowingFunction.apply(Object)方法使用给定的exceptionWrapper包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Return a new BeanInstanceSupplier instance that uses the specified generator function to instantiate the underlying bean.
items.translation: 返回一个新的BeanInstanceSupplier实例，该实例使用指定的generator函数来实例化底层 bean。
